paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for AI-driven PCB design in KiCad. A plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness des
ign PCBs with KiCad.
# dsh-kicad
English | 中文
KiCad for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a native dsh plugin bundle that lets the agent read, edit and chec
k KiCad schematics, with KiCad itself (`kicad-cli`) deciding whether the design is correct.
> Developer preview. Built and tested against dsh `0.2.1-rc.2` and KiCad `10.0.7`. dsh's plugin APIs
are pre-stable, so every package pins `engines.dsh` to `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`.
## What you get
| Surface | What it does |
| **Tools** (`kicad_*`) | `doctor` (is this machine ready: kicad-cli and KiCad 8+, libraries, Python
, with fixes and install commands), `read_schematic`, `list_components`, `get_symbol_pins`, `list_ne
ts` (KiCad netlist), `search_symbols` (installed libraries), `erc`, `drc`, `render` (SVG, PNG attach
ed as an image for image-capable models; for boards KiCad's 3D view from any side or angle), `export
` (netlist/BOM), `simulate` (SPICE verification with ngspice: operating point, transient and AC runs
, with requirement assertions judged on the numbers, see Simulation), `sim_model` (find the SPICE mo
dels in a model file or folder, with their pins), `check_mcu` (static check of how a microcontroller
is wired, see MCU wiring check), `datasheet` (read a part's datasheet PDF: its sections, search, wh
ole pages) and `check_design` (unit tests for the schematic, quoted from the datasheets; see Datashe
et checks), `simulate_firmware` (run an ATtiny or ESP32 firmware against the board, see Firmware aga
inst the board), `export_fab` (Gerber/drill/position/BOM zip with 3D previews, refused until KiCad f
inds the board ready, see Fab output), `fab_preset` (JLCPCB/PCBWay design rules), `create_schematic`

[长行截断]
| **Policy** | Design edits go through dsh approval (`ask`); writes are confined to the sess
ion's working directory (a monotonic guard); after every successful edit KiCad ERC (schematic) or DR
C (board edit or fab preset, zones refilled; with the schematic parity count after `update_pcb`) run
s and its verdict is appended to the tool result, and so are the project's design checks that fail a
fter a schematic edit; the system prompt gets stable KiCad working rules and a dynamic "KiCad projec

t in this directory + last ERC/DRC" context. |
[该节后续省略]
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Design decisions:
- **Files first, headless.** Schematics are edited as files (`.kicad_sch` S-expressions) and judged
with `kicad-cli`; no KiCad GUI is needed. The IPC API (`kipy`) is only an optional live channel (`ip

c_status`), because it needs a running GUI and admits one client at a time.
- **Python sidecar**, no

t Node → IPC: KiCad's IPC is NNG + protobuf with an official binding only for Python.
- **KiCad deci

des.** ERC/DRC verdicts come from `kicad-cli`, never from the model.
- **Narrow dsh coupling.** Each
package touches dsh only through one adapter module (`src/dsh.ts`, `src/client/dsh.ts`); the Client
uses public seams only (`sidebarRightTabs`, keyed slots, `remote.workspaceFiles`, `remote.commands`
, config forms) and imports no dsh Client package, as dsh asks of third-party UI plugins.
## Requirements
- dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3` (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`), Node `>=22.19`, pnpm 11 (for building from

source)
- Python `>=3.10` on `PATH` (`python3`; `python` on Windows) — no Python packages needed for

the core
- KiCad 8+ with `kicad-cli` (tested with 10.0.7). Found via the setting, `$KICAD_CLI`, `PA

TH`, macOS/Windows install dirs, or Flatpak `org.kicad.KiCad`
- Optional: `rsvg-convert`, ImageMagic
k or the `png` extra for PNG renders; the `ipc` extra for the IPC channel; ngspice (`ngspice` on `PA
TH`, or `$NGSPICE`) for `kicad_simulate`; `pdftotext` from poppler (`poppler-utils`; or `$PDFTOTEXT`
) for `kicad_datasheet`
### Check your setup and install KiCad
**Plugins → KiCad → KiCad bridge** shows the environment check: each item (kicad-cli, KiCad version
≥ 8, symbol and footprint libraries, Python ≥ 3.10, optional KiCad 3D models, PNG rasterizer and kic
ad-python) with its status and how to fix it. `/kicad-doctor` prints the same in a conversation, and
the model has `kicad_doctor`; a tool that fails because KiCad is missing names the install command.
When KiCad is missing or too old, the page (and the viewer's notice) lists the ways to install it on
missing or too old, the page (and the viewer's notice) lists the ways to install it on this machine:
| Platform | Option | Runs from dsh? |

| Fedora | `sudo dnf install -y kicad` | no: needs root, shown with **Copy command** |
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- Boards are created and kept in sync from the schematic (`kicad_update_pcb`), placed (`auto_place`)
, edited, routed (`kicad_autoroute`), checked and exported (`kicad_export_fab`). Autorouting needs J
ava 25+ and Freerouting, which are installed separately (see Routing); dense boards may keep a few u

nrouted connections for the agent to finish by hand.
- Simulation covers analog behaviour with ngspi
ce; parts without a SPICE model are left out, and firmware, signal integrity, EMC and thermal behavi

our are not simulated. Plain Device:LED / Device:D symbols need `Sim.Device` set (see Simulation).
-
Firmware simulation covers the ATtiny25/45/85 and the classic ESP32 (on Espressif's QEMU, a separat
e install); it refuses what it does not model (see Firmware against the board; on the ESP32 among ot
hers deep sleep, pads driven by I2C, SPI or RMT, WiFi and Bluetooth). MCU checks are otherwise stati
c and only cover families with a provider (classic ESP32, the 8-pin ATtiny25/45/85, the ATmega48/88/
168/328 and the Arduino Nano/UNO today; the ATmega328P's firmware simulation is in progress); other
MCUs are tracked in #31. An ESP32 pin table is only as good as its transcription: verify it against

the datasheet of the exact module.
- Fab presets were read from JLCPCB's and PCBWay's capability pag
es on 2026-10-21 and may drift. The JLC CPL keeps KiCad's rotations; JLCPCB's preview may need per-p

art rotation fixes.
- Edits cover symbols, properties, wires, labels, power symbols, junctions and n

o-connects; hierarchical sheet creation, buses and graphic items are not edited.
- New sub-sheet sym
bols get their instance path from the root sheet one level up; deeper hierarchies may need KiCad's a

nnotation.
- Images reach the model only when the model route declares image input and an attachment

store is mounted; otherwise the render tool returns SVG paths.
- Approval needs an interactive appr

oval channel; headless runs without one deny design edits unless `approval: allow`.

limitations: 自动布线、完整硬件仿真与各类制造输出能力仍受README所述外部组件和平台范围限制。
无头环境若需执行设计编辑，必须显式设置approval: allow，否则相关操作会被拒绝。
